title: Gantt Chart Maker
tip1: Gantt charts are great for project management
tip2: Enter start and end dates to calculate duration automatically
detailed_description: Our free Gantt chart maker helps project managers and teams visualize project timelines with ease. A Gantt chart is a horizontal bar chart that shows project tasks against time, making it essential for project planning and tracking. With this Gantt chart generator, you can create professional project schedules by adding tasks with start dates, end dates, and progress percentages. The visual timeline helps identify task dependencies, overlapping activities, and potential bottlenecks. Perfect for agile sprints, construction projects, marketing campaigns, and software development cycles. Export your Gantt charts as PNG or SVG for presentations and reports. No signup required - start creating your project timeline instantly in your browser.
usage_steps: Click 'Add Task' to create your first project task
Enter task name, start date, and end date for each task
Set progress percentage to track completion status
Choose a color theme that matches your project style
Preview your Gantt chart and download as PNG or SVG
usage_examples: Create a software development sprint timeline with phases like Planning, Development, Testing, and Deployment
Build a marketing campaign Gantt chart showing content creation, review, and launch dates
Plan a construction project with milestones for foundation, framing, electrical, and finishing
